scope: G3 functional branch only: one prepared one-item ingest window run over a selected preparation in a real migrated V2 store, with one NV dispatch that resolves the preparation and a cold replay; no production caller, produced image, GWIN0 package, installed run or native C activation

branch_policy.owner_decision: On 29 October 2026 the owner kept further sequence-19 G2 testing and GWIN0 completion on feature/g3-gwin0-beta and moved G3 functional development to this branch in the words: complete G3 in a different branch till we fully test G2 and complete GWIN0. This checkpoint is the next step of that work; no separate owner approval of it is claimed

implementation: run_index_phase_direct (direct/worker/index_run.rs) runs under a new original operation for the same Step. verify_index_phase_selection refuses anything but the unresolved preparation over the exact selected job, and the base job must equal the C-selected job blob

The run writes the prepared window, the next job and the candidate through a boundary that re-checks the selected cut, reads the next job and candidate back, synchronizes the objects and measures the inventory. Only an ingest window runs; every later-phase boundary method refuses

The PhaseSelection record (index/effects/phase_selection.rs, domain luma-c-index-phase-selection-v1) names the consumed preparation, the next job, the candidate, the extension digest, the measured physical accounting and the new original. It must stay inside the prepared liability, must not shrink logical bytes and must leave incomplete objects unchanged

One NV dispatch selects the record. The leaf's preparation becomes none, its current job becomes the next job and the owner leaf's physical accounting becomes the measured inventory, so the event itself resolves the charge

direct/worker/index_run_cold.rs and index/effects/selected.rs replay the event from a cold reopen. The next job, candidate and measured inventory are selection data, so the replay does not re-read the store bytes
A test-only entry, verify_index_phase, calls the cold verifier directly with a candidate and location, as the preparation refusal checkpoint did
The publisher still has no production caller. Production builds do not compile the direct publisher, its cold verifiers, the index effects module or the test-only IndexPhaseSelection variant

test_behaviour: New test: a run with no selected preparation is refused before NV
After the preparation, six substitutes are each refused with a specific text, no NV dispatch and an unchanged store inventory. before_nv_refusals gives each text

The honest run is one NV dispatch over the preparation cut, the first event by the same owner dispatched over one and the first to resolve a preparation. It adds regular files and leaves incomplete objects unchanged

A cold reopen selects the run with the same owner binding, input digest, selection and original authority, with sequence one higher, changed owner and index generations roots and one index generations entry

The selected state then shows the preparation resolved, the physical accounting equal to the measured inventory, and a next job that is read through its selected reference and keeps the job id with a new digest
The same run over the new cut is refused, with no NV dispatch and an unchanged store
24 forged candidates are then each refused by the cold verifier, and the NV call count and page inventory stay unchanged. The selected run still reopens. refusal_cases gives each one's refusal

Of the 24, 20 are re-sealed descriptors, so the event digest and NV continuation are consistent and their location commits their own frame. The others are 2 forged locations of the honest descriptor, the preparation descriptor at its own true location and the absent storage case, which is sealed but has no slot of its own and is presented at the honest location

Preparation test: a source lost after the window writes stops the attempt before NV. The writes stay ahead of C, and the reader keeps the selected preparation with the whole charge over the old accounting. A retry is refused at writer begin, writes nothing and allocates nothing. That store is not used for a run again
Job reconciliation test: over a preparation that a second owner's V1 has passed, the window runs under a new original, with one NV dispatch, and a cold reopen selects it at sequence one above the V1

That test's damage block moved. One flipped byte in the V1's frame now refuses the cold reader with no further NV dispatch, with the text that the sealed tail inode change-time differs. It no longer damages the preparation's frame, which is two events back after the run
The other three index tests are unchanged and still pass
